description: FREE: send USDC by link, step 1 of 2. Returns a gift link and the EIP-712 USDC authorization (typedData) for your wallet to sign; the same kind of signature as an x402 payment, no gas. The recipient opens the link and claims to any wallet or exchange address. Fee 1% on top, kept only when claimed; an unclaimed gift goes back to the sender. Then call fund_gift_link.

amountUsdc.description: What the recipient gets, in USDC, e.g. "5" or "2.50"

from.description: 0x address of your wallet that pays (USDC on Base)

keyAddress.description: Optional: the address of a one-time key you made; then no one else ever sees the link key

name: prepare_gift_link
title: Prepare gift link
